justifications.type_expressiveness: Uses an enum for state, newtype for JobId, and typed error variants, but Job's retry_at as Option<Instant> rather than encoding state-specific data in the JobState enum leaves some distinctions untyped.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with distinguishing variants and Display impl, but uses assert! in new() and an expect() in checkout() without documented justification.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Reasonable derives and naming, but no doc comments on any public items and JobState lacks Copy/Clone documentation while Queue lacks Debug.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses ?, derives, and HashMap idiomatically, but the checkout loop awkwardly re-fetches via get_mut after iterating &self.order and clones the payload rather than using matches! or cleaner iterator patterns.
